'''''Star Wars: Jedi of the Republic – Mace Windu''''' is a [[Marvel Comics|Marvel]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] miniseries written by [[Matt Owens]] and illustrated by [[Denys Cowan]]. The comic is set shortly after the events of [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']], and centers on the character of [[Mace Windu]]. The five-issue series began publication in [[August]] [[2017]] and concluded on [[December 27]].<ref name="Announcement" />
